summary: Ruby Life Pools rewards planned early trash pulls, coordinated interrupts and dispels, disciplined space usage, and prioritizing Kyrakka in the final encounter.
actions: Interrupt Ice Shield, Frigid Shard, Fiery Blast, and Blaze Volley; remove Cold Claws, Rolling Thunder, and Stormslam.
Purge Blaze of Glory and Stormcloud Barrier.
Account for Defier Draghar as a mandatory high-health progression enemy when planning the opening route.
Avoid being knocked into Hailbombs after Chillstorm and kite Kokia gradually to preserve room.
On the final encounter, prioritize Kyrakka whenever the dragon is attackable at range and defeat it first.
